gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-spline-sans: Beads on a long thread: Bruno Ace SC strings open letters with no calligraphic thinning. Spline Sans is the steady part: vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight, with wide gaps at curve ends.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-outfit: Beaded and open, Bruno Ace SC strings its letters along a long thread without any calligraphic thinning. Outfit does the quieter job, bending cable-like sans-serif curves that stop short of closing.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-chillax: Horseshoe-wide c and sturdy diagonals give Cherry Swash its punch. Chillax then loosens everything, its spaghetti-like sans line leaving loops unfinished, so the page moves from firm statement to easy chat.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-plus-jakarta-sans: Commanding, Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe. Plus Jakarta Sans takes over below with a monoline sans-serif build and well-spaced curve endings, so extended reading stays smooth and precise.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-space-grotesk: Below Cherry Swash, the text reads in an unbroken ribbon of constant width. Space Grotesk keeps its counters open like a cut reed, so sustained sans-serif reading goes smoothly beneath that commanding heading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-plein: Comic Relief has strokes as stout as a drawn pipe cleaner. It brings bold, commanding punch up top, while Plein, a reliable sans-serif, keeps a clear channel leading into each round letter.
gen-gf-comic-relief-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans stays modern and monoline under the bold Comic Relief. Its curve endings sit well apart, so page after page in this sans feels crisp and precise rather than crowded.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-familjen-grotes: Funnel Display is spaghetti-like, with strokes of constant width and open c tips. Familjen Grotesk adds lively sans text whose lowercase stands tall against its capitals, giving that expressive heading some company.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-general-sans: Tube-like and loud, Tilt Neon splays its c terminal and carries a large x-height. General Sans can take a modest size beneath it, since its x-height fills the line.
gen-gf-warnes-work-sans: Stretched and spacious, Warnes lets its ink strokes taper out before they touch, with no contrast. Work Sans sits below it with a high mean line and firm joins, giving the text a modern footing.
